note: High/critical advisories accepted for the build-only toolchain. The shipped site and book artifacts have no runtime Node dependencies; `npm audit --omit=dev` is the release gate. Each entry needs a review date and cannot be extended silently.

entries.title: Quadratic-time denial of service in inline HTML parsing with html enabled
entries.reason: Only reachable from the markdownlint-cli build tool; not used to render the public site or the book. Upstream fix lands with the next markdownlint-cli bump.

entries.title: Quadratic-time rendering of a single multi-line link reference definition
entries.reason: Build-tool only, no untrusted Markdown is rendered. Track the next markdownlint-cli release.

entries.title: Cross origin script execution through Vite custom middleware
entries.reason: Vite 6 is pinned by VitePress 1.6.4 and there is no patched release yet. The dev server binds locally only; the deployed site is static.

entries.title: Files outside server.fs.allow could be served when project paths match system paths
entries.reason: Same pinned Vite 6.4.3; dev-server only. Revisit with a VitePress upgrade.

entries.title: launch-editor escapeCmdArgs() omits % escaping on Windows
entries.reason: launch-editor is only invoked from a local dev server on the developer's own machine.

entries.title: launch-editor editor CLI flag misinterpretation
entries.reason: Local dev-server only; no untrusted editor configuration is used here.

entries.title: launch-editor existsSync() existence check can be bypassed on Windows
entries.reason: Windows-specific local dev-server risk; CI runs on Linux and the published site is static.
